definition: Technical and governance activities that enable controlled exchange and reuse of data across systems, institutions or sectors. Includes interoperability frameworks, APIs, data exchange platforms, interoperability layers, service buses, common identifiers, shared data models, semantic standards, data-sharing agreements, consent and authorisation controls, audit, open standards and cross-agency integration. Excludes static publication with no exchange or reuse mechanism, network connectivity alone, integration limited to one product deployment, and informal coordination with no technical or governance mechanism for sharing data.
